lesson_title: LESSON 07: Sharing the Road & Special Circumstances
prompt: What is the core objective of the Community Safety Education Act (Senate Bill 30) enacted in Texas?

options.text: Eliminate traffic stops by replacing police officers with automated cameras
Define mutual rights and expectations during traffic stops to ensure safety
Increase traffic ticket fine revenue collected by county justice courts
Mandate that all high school seniors complete police cadet training camps
